title: First-Time Resume & Bio-Data Helper
problem: My cousin wants to apply for a billing job at a town supermarket, but he feels embarrassed because he doesn't know how to write a bio-data.
idea: A bio-data helper. Tick what your bio-data has, follow the steps, and try a quick quiz on what to put and what to leave out.

widgets.heading: ✅ Does my bio-data have everything?
widgets.intro: Tick each part you have written.

items.text: Full name, phone number and village/town
Job I am applying for (e.g., Billing Assistant)
Skills: computer basics, billing, Telugu, English, Hindi
Work experience (even helping in a family shop)
Short line about me: honest, punctual, good with customers
Checked spelling and kept it to 1 page

bands.text: Super! Your bio-data is ready to print. 🎉
Almost there. Fill the missing parts.
Let's add more details before printing.

questions.q: Should you write false marks to look better?
questions.why: Employers check certificates. Honesty builds trust.

questions.q: Is helping in your father's kirana shop 'experience'?
questions.why: Handling customers and money is real billing experience!

questions.q: Do you need to write your Aadhaar number on a bio-data?
questions.why: Share Aadhaar only when officially asked, not on every bio-data.

how: Sit with your cousin and write his details on paper: name, education, skills, experience.
Type the details into Gemini and ask it to write a clean 1-page bio-data.
Check every line is true and correct.
Open Canva, search 'Simple resume' and pick a clean template.
Paste the text, keep fonts simple, and download it as PDF.
Print 3 copies and practise a short self-introduction for the interview.
prompt: Write a simple 1-page bio-data for my cousin applying for a Billing Assistant job at a supermarket. Details: Name Ravi Kumar, Intermediate (CEC) passed 2024, knows MS Excel basics and Tally basics, speaks Telugu, Hindi and English, helped in family kirana shop for 2 years. Keep it honest and simple.
